core_obligations: Case A (proof lines 1286-1327): h_n corresponds to the continuous v_n; v_total is defined degree by degree and is continuous; h_total^{-1} = v_{total,s}, h_{total,*} = v^p; the identity (g'_n)^{-1} h_{total,*} = h_{n,*} g_n^{-1} holds by computing sections over an object of C'_n, so h_{total,*}F corresponds to the system (h_{n,*}F_n, h_{n,*}F(varphi)); on systems its left adjoint is (F'_n, F'(varphi)) |-> (h_n^{-1}F'_n, h_n^{-1}F'(varphi)); by uniqueness of adjoints h_total^{-1} acts by this rule, whence it is exact (h_n^{-1} exact, sheaves-on-total description) and h_total is a morphism of topoi; the companion identity g_n^{-1} h_total^{-1} = h_n^{-1} (g'_n)^{-1} proves the displayed square commutes.

Case B (lines 1329-1350): v_total : C_total -> C'_total is degree-wise cocontinuous and h_total is its associated morphism of topoi; the diagram commutes by the Sites composition lemma; taking left adjoints, the final equality becomes h_total^{-1} (g'_n)^{Sh}_! = g^{Sh}_{n!} h_n^{-1}, which follows from the explicit shriek descriptions of the restriction-to-components lemma, the base-change identity h_n^{-1}(f'_varphi)^{-1} = f_varphi^{-1} h_m^{-1} for varphi : [m] -> [n], and the established commutation of h_total^{-1} with the degree-n restrictions.
proof_roadmap: Case A: build the continuous v_total, identify the total direct image systemwise, conclude with uniqueness of adjoints and exactness.
Case B: build the cocontinuous v_total, transfer the shriek compatibility from the explicit component formulas.
difficulty_reason: Morphism-construction lemma (statement 1272-1284, proof 1286-1350): both site variants are handled - case A identifies the total direct image as a system and finishes with uniqueness of adjoints, case B transfers the shriek compatibility from explicit component formulas; the two verifications marked 'immediate' name their inputs (the section computation, the shriek formulas plus the base-change identity), recorded in the notes. H2: site-theoretic construction with an adjoint-uniqueness finish.
